evidence.quote: While growth has been frustratingly slow, employment gains have been solid.
we are now close to meeting our dual mandate--a reasonable summary statistic for the effects of policy.
the bottom line is that there has not been an excessive buildup of leverage, maturity transformation, or broadly unsustainable asset prices.
the current extended period of very low nominal rates calls for a high degree of vigilance against the buildup of risks to the stability of the financial system.
low interest rates have supported economic activity and gradually brought us back to full employment and 2 percent inflation.

parsed.rationale: The speech defends low-for-long rates and finds financial stability risks contained, while noting the economy is near full employment and 2 percent inflation. It gives no explicit rate-path signal, so the net stance is roughly neutral with a slight hawkish tilt from the near-mandate assessment and the call for vigilance.
